items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: Tom Albert, he was a great guy. He used to come over to see my daddy... Tom Albert, he come over and he and my daddy got to be personal friends.

ctx.x: When you mention parade and second line, do you mean that they actually, um, followed behind him when he played?

Yes, they had the other people, uh, I mean the people over there, they would, uh, follow behind my dad and his little band over there. Oh, I can't call some of the other people, that guy from over here that played with him. And, Cap, he was, just as started on clarinet. And, he come over here with Tom Albert. And, that's when he began to get with Tuck Johnson and other bands. I can't call all the names because some I know and some I don't know. And, then he finally, he got his own band. They called it the Haines,…
Well, you couldn't have been that young.
